label: First Way mover as NECESSARY_2: causal, POTENCY_1, essence-esse and grounding routes
summary: Owner lead 2026-11-22 (pure actuality to necessary existence), God-existence stage of the root. Question: does the SAME individual the prima via delivers (IsFirstUnmovedMover, pure act by the existing derivations of 6c18d52b) exist at every world accessible from w (NecessaryAt, NECESSARY_2), without assuming it necessary or identifying it with an independently derived necessary root (B7)? Built (batch specs/first-mover-necessity.toml, module TruthCore.Causality.FirstMoverNecessity over one CausalityFrame, analyst formulations, attribution deferred): five same-witness routes, each Lean-checked with Comparator and NanoDa. Common inputs: prima via conclusion 7bce7007, B0 'whatever moves something exists at w' (bd0a4f81), excluded middle. (A or B, 563d596e) firstness 74eb9113, pure act 6c18d52b, B3 ee74c678 and the disjunctive bridge 3c9d683b (every contingent being is in POTENCY_1 or has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse; weakest, implied by B2 and by B4). (A, 8cc169e3) B2 8a8d00e9 with firstness and B3; pure act carried. (B, 52df4a80) B4 753269b3 with pure act alone. (C, e874589f) B6 96971e31 (contingent implies esse distinct from essence) with the existing simplicity statement 78246da5. (Grounding, 99ec0afb) existing closure c71c068c, grounding-priority 7a63a3fe, new irreflexivity 2047d14b and B0' 6e6c5d8d, giving 11958874: the mover is a necessary actual first pure-act root. B2 is also derived from B6, 0436de86 and the q.3 a.4 reading 33ad148b (b46b88c8). Projections connect the First Way's witness to the existing endpoint 593d7307 (930c6d8c) and to the root-route stage-one node STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT b19ffd92 (b6d7c434 from 11958874; 402e5643 from f9208664 with B0'). frontier-diff vs the merge base 08d5aa22: 10 verified support alternatives added (including the b19ffd92 option through the First Way, and 7bce7007's existing Fifth Way supports, which now reach the root), 6 bare premises added (B0, B0', irreflexivity, B4, B2 or B4, B6), route cost unchanged; no premise closed. Models (controls 2b71a3ad, finite frames with two respects, esse and motion, structural surrogates; the moved thing is in POTENCY_1 in the respect in which it is moved): bruteFirst (M1/M2/M4) is a first-in-being, pure-act, simple mover satisfying both existing potency/modality bridges nonvacuously (every potency is of the contradictory; what can fail to be possibly is not) that is contingent and uncaused: B2, B4, the esse-tied half B4b, B2 or B4, B6 and the grounding closure fail, so pure act alone, essence-esse identity alone and firstness alone leave necessity open. conserved (M3): a pure-act mover caused in esse by a prior being, contingent; firstness fails, so POTENCY_1 pure act does not exclude received esse. Models 2-10 omit every other premise in turn; model 11 satisfies every route nonvacuously; model 12 (M5, three beings) has two necessary actual first pure-act roots, the mover and an idle being, so no endpoint identifies the mover with every necessary root. Shared dependencies: all routes share the prima via conclusion, B0 and pure act; firstness 74eb9113 enters A, A or B and grounding directly, C through the derivation of simplicity and B through two of the five derivations of pure act (the Lambda.7 de01c6e3 and temporal e67e0be2 derivations avoid it); B2 through B6 shares B6 with C; B3 is derived through 7a63a3fe. Rivals under the substantive objection standard: against B4 as typed (POTENCY_1 in any respect, no tie to esse) no substantive objection is identified: the distinctness of the two channels in DISAMB-POTENCY-IN-SUBJECT-VS-IN-ANOTHER shows only that B4 is not a conceptual truth, the conserved model only that it is needed, and a counterexample would be a contingent being in POTENCY_1 in no respect, which presupposes the denial of the target (open B5 question); with excluded middle B4 is equivalent to 'every pure-act being existing at w is necessary at w' (law 3), so route B relocates the question; B2 or B4 is the weakest bridge as typed but is not the q.9 a.2 pair of channels without two unrecorded bridges (contingency to MUTABLE_3; another's power over esse to a distinct esse-cause); against B2 and B2 or B4 the brute contingent first being (same rival as SpineRivalsRootEsse.ContingentRootSurvives at the necessary-root node; price: a contingent existent that is in POTENCY_1 in no respect and has no distinct cause of its esse, with no explanation of its existence); against B6 no specific substantive objection identified beyond that rival, but represented essence-esse identity has no modal force by itself (DISAMB-ESSENTIAL-VS-ACCESSIBLE-EXISTENCE). No substantive objection identified to B0, B0' or irreflexivity. Duper discovery (scripts/run-discovery.sh, --premise-pool all, 8 candidates, 100000 heartbeats): before (records not yet registered) targets 593d7307 and b19ffd92: 0 proved, 2 unresolved, 0 filtered; the First Way statements were not among the candidates (retrieval miss: the First Way vocabulary has no world or profile carrier). After: targets f9208664, 11958874, 3c9d683b, 8a8d00e9, 753269b3, 96971e31, 593d7307, b19ffd92: 2 proved, 2 discoveries, 0 filtered as known, 6 unresolved. Discoveries (conditional support options, not records): f9208664 from 11958874 alone (the grounding endpoint implies the pure-act endpoint, a projection not registered here) and 3c9d683b from 753269b3 alone (law 5 of the controls, not registered as its own argument). Unresolved: B2, B4, B6 (missing substantive premise: the models show them independent of the rest); B2's candidates missed 33ad148b/0436de86 (retrieval miss: the q.3 a.4 profile is constructed from frame fields); 593d7307 and b19ffd92 candidates missed the new endpoints (carrier misidentification: the Profile is constructed from the frame, not a parameter projection), though both connections are registered. Provisional judgment (unreviewed): valid under each bundle; pure actuality on POTENCY_1 does not by itself entail necessity; it does work only with firstness, closing the potency disjunct of B2 or B4; A or B dominates A (A's bundle entails it); the grounding route adds no modal crux beyond the closure c71c068c; other route comparisons are not decided (no assessed warrant differential; logical weakness is not warrant); the result is cross-family convergence on one witness, not independent corroboration against brute contingency. Independent semantic challenge on PR #1870 (reviewed head b3548f81) accepted every theorem and the same-witness claim; repairs 2026-11-23: B4 and B2 or B4 prose restated to their types, the objection to B4 withdrawn as not substantive against the typed premise, B4's classical equivalence with the target recorded (law 3), the ranking restricted to stated reasons, models repaired so that moved things are in potency (two respects; a third idle being for M5), B0 scope, irreflexivity scope and definition links. Note: docs/notes/modal-spine.md, 'The First Way's own mover as the necessary being (2026-11-22)'. The existing B6 and B2/first mover same-witness consumers remain unchanged. General control proves R1 + the proposed R2 transfer to ADOPTED unactualized subject POTENCY_1 at esse + ExistsAt→InAct at esse exclude all actual contingent beings; R2 is NOT positive B4 support. Nonvacuous receiver, externally conserved contingent mover and unreceived brute first models distinguish the senses and show the crux, only as structural surrogates. Positive warrant and surviving open commitments recorded in docs/notes/modal-spine.md. Follow-on research 2026-11-23: positive R1 case developed as substantive Thomistic participation of a finite essence in its act of esse, with an explicit scope limit that modal contingency alone entails neither reception nor essence/esse real composition. R3 is defended narrowly as no other receiver for the same self-subsistent esse; receptive irreflexivity excludes same-principle potency-to-its-own-act, not self-reference universally. The strongest rival is a primitive contingent actual being with determinate real nature, laws and optional nonnecessitating intrinsic explanation, still unreceived; its metaphysical admissibility is disputed, not settled by Bool controls. Two conditional same-world actual-giver support routes are registered: R1 + received-esse CAUSE_2 coverage + cause presence (8d8920ac); or R1/R3/De ente/irreflexivity + selected-world actuality + q3a4 external cause + cause presence (a3f7a9eb). Projection d2d55c9b restores old B2, then the existing First Way proof retains exactly the same mover. Both routes share R1 and UnitingCausesPresent, and neither asserts continuous giving, actual sufficiency of internal reasons, or existence of a unique ultimate giver. See docs/notes/modal-spine.md, 'Contingency, participation and an actual giver of esse (2026-11-23)'. No new historical source claim.
blocker: OPEN warrant: why every contingent finite actual individual must have a real receptive principle (R1), rather than unreceived primitive contingent actuality or adequately specified intrinsic nonnecessitating existence; R3's self-subsistent-act scope and receptive irreflexivity under real principle identity; contingent token-existence vs probability/contrastive adequacy. The actual-giver result also separately depends on OPEN reception-to-CAUSE_2 coverage OR q.3 a.4, and in BOTH cases the selected-world actual-cause presence interface (UnitingCausesPresent), which does not follow from InAct c esse or the atemporal CausesIn label. The existing firstness/priority commitments plus B2 still support NECESSARY_2 of the SAME First Way mover, not universality of its causal giving or uniqueness. New result CI, Comparator/NanoDa and independent semantic review are pending at this unreviewed revision; no premise closed or metaphysical possibility certificate asserted.
